book.name: Luka
book.title: Malobhi Manyahi ngati moghalembakike na Luka

content: Yesu andamiha mtamwa mu Lichobha la Sabato
Mu Lichobha limu la Sabato, Yesu akapiti kula chilebhe kunyumba jaka mundu jumu nkolongwa wa Mafalisayo, na bhandu bhabhakabhi panipala bhakabhi bhundingalakila.
Mundu jumu joakabhi na chitamu cha kuhimba hyegha akabhi palongi jaka Yesu.
Yesu akabhalalukili bhabhola bha Shelia na Mafalisayo, “Bho, Shelia jitu le jilaghalaki kundamiha mundu mu Lichobha la Sabato au nga wichu?”
Nambu bhombi bhakatemi chinunu. Yesu akamkamwi mtamwa jola, akandamihi na kundeka ajendaje.
Bhela Yesu akabhalaluki bhandu bhala, “Bho, mundu bhole pachilanda jinu anangati mwana waki au ng'ombi jaki anayijibhi muchilibha mu Lichobha la Sabato joayilepa kujenda kwipiya?”
Nambu bhombi ngachebhaweziki kumuyanga lilobhi lokapi lela.
Kulihelea na kubhajangati bhandu
Yesu paabhaweni bhagheni bhabhakokakiki bhala bhahaghu itehu ya kutopela, akabhapwaghi ulenganesu aghoghu,
“Chikahi mundu paakukoka pa ukwati, ngawitama pandu pa kutopela. Maghambu pangi pachilanda ja bhabhakokiki kubhi na mundu wa kutopela kukupeta wehapa,

na anahiki mwenei winu joankokiki mwanganya mabhokapi nhwikaje ayihika na kukupwaghila, ‘Undekila mundu ajoju chitehu hechi.’ Panihapa wipowakika lihamu palongi ja bhandu bhokapi na wijenda kutama kwitehu yanga kutopela.

Nambu anabhukukokiki paukwati, utama kwitehu yanga kutopela, nahuli joankokiki paahikaje akupwaghila ‘Nkochi wangu, uhika utama pani palongi, pandu panyahi nakanopi.’ Panihapa wibya utopile palongi ja bhandu bhokapi bhawitama naku kula chilebhe.
Maghambu mundu jokapi joalikweha mweni anahelakikaje, na mundu jokapi joaliheleha, anakwehakikaje.”

Bhela Yesu akampwaghi mundu joakankokiki jola, “Chikahi pauwandaa uwangalalu wa chilebhe cha muhi au cha pakamihi, ngawakoka bhakochi bhaku au bhalongu bhaku au bhandu bha pambipi au bhana hindu yamahele. Anauhengiki bhenibhela, na bhombi anabhukukoka kumanyumba ghabhu, na wehapa wibya bhakulepiki ngati chewahengile.
Nambu pauhenga uwangalalu wa kula chilebhe, wabhakoka bhahochu, ilema, bhabhatengwiki na akangalola,
nanaghu wibya upengaliki, maghambu bhandu habha ngachebhabhi na chakukulepa. Chapanga anaakulepa mu lichobha la kuyohakeka kwa bhandu bhambone.”
Ulenganesu wa uwangalalu ukolongwa wa kula chilebhe

Jumu wa bhala bhabhakabhi bhakula chilebhe papamu na Yesu paakajowini malobhi ghanihagha, akumpwaghile, “Bhapengaliki bhandu bhokapi bhabhitama kula chilebhe cha uwangalalu mu Ukolongwa waka Chapanga!”
Yesu akamuyangiki, “Mundu jumu akatendiki uwangalalu ukolongwa wa kula chilebhe na kubhakoka bhandu bhamahele.
Chikahi cha kula chilebhe cha uwangalalu pachahikike, mundu jola akuntumiki mtumika waki akabhalohaje bhabhakokakiki, ‘Muhikaje, kila chindu chibhi wichu!’
Nambu bhokapi bhakatumbwi kubhoha ndandi ya kulepa kuhika. Mundu wa kutumbula akumpwaghi mtumika jola, ‘Nhemi ngonda na mbalika nyenda nakulingaje, chondi nganhike.’
Mundu jongi akapwaghiki, ‘Nhemi ng'ombi mapongu komi gha kulemela, henu nyenda kwilengesha, chondi nganhike.’
Bhelabhela mundu jongi akapwaghiki, ‘Ndotwi mbomba, na bhela nganhike.’

“Mtumika jola akakelawiki, na kundandi bambo waki mambu ghanihagha ghokapi. Panihapa bambo jola akahakalile na kumpwagii mtumika waki, ‘Ujenda kanyata mwijiji, na mwindela ya muchi, na ukabhaleta bhahochu, ilema, akangalola, na bhabhatengwike na kubhapwaghi bhahikaje.’
Palongi pachokope mtumika jola akakelawiki na kupwagha, ‘Bambo, kila chindu kihenghakiki wichu ngati mowalaghalakile, nambu mbekenyu ja kutama bhandu jikale.’
Bhela bambo jola akampwaghi mtumika waki, ‘Ujenda mwindela ya muchi na mwijiji na ukabhalazimisha bhandu bhahikaje, nahuli nyumba jangu jitwelalaje.
Maghambu numpwaghila nga mundu nga jumu pachilanda ja bhanakokiki joanahonja chilebhi cha uwangalalu wangu!’ ”
Ghaghapalika kwa kubha mbulwa
Bhela mapogha ghamaheli gha bhandu bhakabhi bhunjengale Yesu, jombi akang'anambwiki na kubhapwaghila bhandu,
“Mundu jokapi joanyengale nepani anaabya chakaka mbulwa wangu ngati anaambai nepani kupeta atati na mabhu waki, nhwanu waki na bhana bhaki, bhabheli bhaki na bhalombu bhaki, na mweni.
Mundu jokapi jwanga kunyamula msalaba waki na kunyengalela nepani, ngaawezi kubha mbulwa wangu.”
“Bho, mundu bholi pachilanda jinu joapala kuchenga mnala, joailepa kutumbu kutama pahi na kubhalanga mbija yeabhi nayu kwa kuchenga, nahuli amanya ngati abhi na mbija yeilenganela kwa kujomulela?
Kwa kubha ngati anaatumbwi kuchenga luhuli, na kulepale kujomule kuchenga, bhandu bhokapi bhabhabhona cheakihengike bhitenda kunheka.
Bhela bhipwagha, ‘Mundu ajoju akatumbwi kuchenga nambu ngacheaweziki kujomulela lihengu laki!’

“Au nkolongwa bholi joajenda kukomana na nkolongwa jongi, jwanga kutumbu kutama pahi, na kuholalela ngati anaweza kwa manjolinjoli bhaki elufu komi kukomana na jola joabhi na manjolinjoli elufu ishiline?
Jombi ngati ngaayiwezi, anaantumila nkolongwa njaki jola ubholu wa kujopa kujongana kwa lukwale koni jongi hoju akabya akali kutali.”
Yesu akajomuli kwa kupwagha, “Kwa ntundu ghonihoghu, njeta pachilanda jinu joayiweza kubha mbulwa wangu ngati nangakuileka yokapi yeabhi naku.”
Mwinyu wangakupalika
“Mwinyu nde wamboni, nambu mwinyu anauhoiki kunogha kwaki, bho, anaaujeghalika kiki nahuli ukelabhuha kunogha kwaki?
Ngacheupalika kabheti hata kwa kujeghela mungonda wala kuhangaghana na mbolea, nambu bhandu bhaulekela pela. Joabhi na makutu na ajowanaje!”
